skill.name: skill-share
skill.description: Creates Claude skill packages, validates their structure, and shares skill announcements to Slack through Rube for team discovery.
skill.summary: Create, validate, package, and share Claude skills with Slack notifications.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive: the flagged backticks are a markdown code fence in SKILL.md lines 59-66. No prompt injection or malicious semantic intent was found in the audited file. The skill is prompt-only but describes Slack sharing and local file creation requirements users should review.

finding_verdicts.reason: The flagged text at SKILL.md lines 59-66 is a markdown code fence showing example workflow text. It is not Ruby backtick execution and contains no shell command.

content.value_statement: Teams need a repeatable way to create and distribute reusable AI skills. This skill guides skill creation, validation, packaging, and Slack announcements through Rube.
actual_capabilities: Creates structured skill directories with SKILL.md documentation.
Generates standard scripts, references, and assets directories.
Validates skill metadata, naming, and SKILL.md format.
Packages validated skills into distributable zip files.
Posts skill announcements and metadata to Slack through Rube.
limitations: Requires a Slack workspace connection through Rube.
Requires write access to the target skill creation directory.
Expects Python 3.7 or newer for skill creation scripts.
The audited package contains only SKILL.md; implementation depends on the active assistant and integrations.

use_cases.title: Standardize Internal Skill Creation
use_cases.description: Create repeatable skill packages with required metadata, folders, validation, and packaging steps.

use_cases.title: Notify Teams About New Skills
use_cases.description: Share skill names, descriptions, summaries, and links in Slack so teammates can discover new tools.

use_cases.title: Prepare Skills For Distribution
use_cases.description: Validate structure and package completed skills before sharing them with a team or workspace.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Basic Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-share to create a Claude skill named release-notes-helper. It should draft release notes from ticket summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Validate And Package A Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-share to validate my existing customer-research skill, fix missing metadata, and package it for team distribution.

prompt_templates.title: Share A Skill To Slack
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-share to create a database-migration-review skill and post a concise announcement to our engineering Slack channel.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Team Skill Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-share to define a reusable workflow for creating, validating, packaging, and announcing internal Claude skills.

output_examples.input: Create a pdf-analyzer skill and prepare it for team sharing.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates the skill structure, validates required metadata, prepares a package, and drafts a Slack announcement for review.

output_examples.input: Validate my support-triage skill before I share it.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks naming, required fields, folder structure, and package readiness, then reports any changes needed.

output_examples.input: Announce the new onboarding-helper skill to Slack.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares a short Slack message with the skill name, description, summary, and available file links.

best_practices: Review Slack announcement content before posting to a broad channel.
Use clear hyphen-case names that match each skill purpose.
Validate SKILL.md metadata before packaging or sharing a skill.
anti_patterns: Do not share skills that contain secrets or private customer data.
Do not skip validation before packaging a skill for teammates.
Do not post announcements to unrelated Slack channels.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It helps create Claude skill folders, SKILL.md metadata, supporting directories, and distributable packages.

faq.question: Does it require Slack?
faq.answer: Slack is required for the sharing workflow because notifications are sent through Rube Slack tools.

faq.question: Can it validate existing skills?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow includes SKILL.md validation, naming checks, and metadata completeness checks.

faq.question: Does it include executable code?
faq.answer: The audited package contains only SKILL.md. It describes scripts and integrations but does not include implementation files.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should teams review before sharing?
faq.answer: Teams should review metadata, package contents, Slack channel targets, and any links included in the announcement.
